svg.title: Hong-Son (Saun) Nguyen — Robotics · Artificial Intelligence · Social Intelligence
svg.desc: A Van Gogh–style animated painting: under a swirling starry sky a small robot crosses a lamp-lit plaza, predicting where people will walk and making room for an oncoming cyclist. A pale-blue plaque with gold trim below reads "Hong-Son (Saun) Nguyen — Robotics · Artificial Intelligence · Social Intelligence — M.S. Researcher @ National Cheng Kung University (NCKU), Taiwan, Networked Robotic Systems Lab (NRSL)".
